exitCodes.meaning: The session ended cleanly — Ctrl-C, the --timeout deadline, or the app's detached/timedOut reply.
Invalid arguments — a malformed --timeout, an unknown flag, or more than one repository path.
The Switchyard app is not running. Watch never launches the app.
The app terminated the session (shutting down) or quit mid-stream — never reported as a detach.

flags.help: Detach after this many seconds, exiting 0. Without it the session runs until the CLI detaches (Ctrl-C) or the app ends it.

summary: Stream repository and app events as newline-delimited JSON until detached.
